title: What the History of Television Can Teach Advertisers About Storytelling
summary: Learn how early TV sponsors pioneered ad storytelling and how to use narrative in your video ads today.
body_markdown:
TL;DR


5


Quick Takeaways


A simple story can make your product’s value more compelling.


1. 1


In Ipsos’s 2026 analysis of 15,000 video ads, ads that told a story were twice as effective at changing behavior.


2. 2


Your story can be simple: introduce a problem, show how your product helps, and pay it off with the outcome.


3. 3


Give viewers a character to root for, with meaningful obstacles and a conclusion that rewards their attention.


4. 4


In QuickFrame and MNTN’s CTV sample, fear-led ads had 49% higher site visit rates, while joy delivered 7% higher conversion rates than average.


5. 5


Use creative research to guide your own tests; findings from one platform show correlations, not guaranteed results.
